test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Hollong (Dipterocarpus macrocarpus) is the tallest tree in the state of ___ and also its State Tree.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Assam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Hollong is the State Tree of Assam.
 
• Hollong is a medium hardwood, timber tree.
 
• It grows naturally in forests of upper Assam and Arunachal Pradesh. Hollong is a sacred tree for the Moran community of Assam.
